description: Two Statistics Canada publication members describe annual and quarterly average air fares by sector and fare-type group, domestic fares for ten selected cities of enplanement, and distributions of passengers and passenger-kilometres. They cover 2015 and 2016 as distinct related issues. One descriptor is PDF and the other HTML. The description does not identify the ten cities, actual fare values, carrier coverage details, weighting methods or whether nominal fares include taxes. These are observed air-transport prices and demand measures, not future fare forecasts. The publication bodies and numerical tables were not retrieved, and no underlying microdata release is asserted. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue preserves source identifiers and descriptive metadata. Provider: Statistics Canada. Licence: License not specified. Costs and current file access are unverified.
